summary: A10 Networks issued an 8-K disclosing a warrant granted to Microsoft for up to 800,000 shares at $0.01 per share, vesting in two tranches tied to Microsoft's purchases of A10 products by June 30, 2027 and 2028. Exercisable after January 1, 2028/2029 until August 3, 2036, with cashless exercise and change-of-control acceleration. This is a commercial arrangement, not a special-situation corporate action; no deal terms beyond the warrant mechanics.
